error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE:
"[SCTP]   Received SCTP SHUTDOWN EVENT"

Context:
This SCTP shutdown event indicates that the SCTP association between the CU and DU has been terminated unexpectedly. Following this, the log shows:
- "Received SCTP state 1 for assoc_id 337, removing endpoint"
- "releasing DU ID 3584 (gNB-Eurecom-DU) on assoc_id 337"

This error is critical as it implies loss of SCTP connectivity, which would prevent further F1AP messaging and thus disrupt the CU-DU interface operation, effectively preventing normal system operation and UE context management.

No stack trace or crash info is present, but the SCTP shutdown event is the most critical error in the log.
